text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each dot is one winter day (November to February, daily-mean ERA5 temperature below 12 °C); blue is the site's first winter after its first usable date, orange its last. Bottom: each winter's least-squares slope with a 95% interval from resampling whole calendar months (points of effective capacity per °C; more negative means more heating load per degree).'
text.tspan: Top: each dot is one winter day (November to February, daily-mean ERA5 temperature below 12
°C); blue is the site's first winter after its first usable date, orange its last. Bottom: each
winter's least-squares slope with a 95% interval from resampling whole calendar months (points
of effective capacity per °C; more negative means more heating load per degree).
